(1.5)
ekadā sphāṭikorvībhṛt sānau vanasamākule | saṃsthitau pārvatīśaṃbhū lokarakṣaṇatatparau || 1 ||
pārvatī parameśānaṃ provāca vacanaṃ hitam | devadeva suraśreṣṭha dayātraiguṇyamānasa || 2 ||
devī bhagavatī deva mahātripurasundarī | asmiṃś carācare vyakte krūre kena prakāśitā || 3 ||
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi gopyaṃ tava kutūhalāt | revātaṭe mahāpuṇye śrīgarbhā nāma satpurī | asti trailokyavikhyātā sarvabhūtalaśekharā || 4 ||
tasyāṃ babhūva viprendradevagandharvasevitam | puṇyaṃ tapovanapadaṃ nānāvṛkṣasamākulam || 5 ||
(1.14)
tasmiṃs tapovane puṇye sevite 'pi munīśvaraiḥ | ṛṣiḥ syād dakṣiṇāmūrtis tadārādhanatatparaḥ | nānāśāstrābdhi poto'pi sarvāgamanidhir abhūt || 6 ||
ekadā snātum āyāto revāṃ puṇyajalānvitām || 7 ||
prākpuṇyakarmaṇā tasmai tuṣṭā tripurasundarī | jalamadhye sthitā goptrī mahātripurasundarī || 8 ||
svamūlaṃ śikṣito devyā śuddhaṃ cāmṛtarūpakam | satvaraṃ phaladaṃ gopyaṃ sa munīndraśiromaṇiḥ || 9 ||
tadā prabhṛti tanmantraṃ dhyāyan stotraṃ japan hṛdi | tatprabhāvān mahādevi granthaṃ kartum iyeṣa saḥ || 10 ||
tadanugrahamātreṇa sa munīśvarapūjitaḥ | grantham uddhārakośākhyaṃ cakāra mantrasāgaram || 11 ||
anyān nānāvidhān granthān prekṣya trailokyapūjite | tadā prabhṛti deveśi prasiddhaṃ bhūmimaṇḍale | grantham uddhārakośākhyaṃ sarvāgamaviniścitam || 12 ||
śrīdevyuvāca
devadeva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka | śrotum uddhārakośākhyaṃ nānāgamaviniścitam | icchāmi paramaprītyā vaktum arhasi dhūrjaṭe || 13 ||
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu pārvati vakṣyāmi hyuddhāraṃ tripurāditaḥ | devīnāṃ daśavidyānāṃ mantroddhāram anuttamam || 14 ||
(1.19)
grantham uddhārakośākhyaṃ sarvāgamaviniścitam | sarvagranthādipūjyaṃ ca tacchṛṇuṣva bravīmyaham || 15 ||
tadanugrahamātreṇa sarvān uddhārasaṃcayān | abravīd dakṣiṇāmūrtiśchātram akṣobhyanāmakam || 16 ||
śṛṇu chātra mahābhāgin devībhaktisamanvita | rahasyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ devānām api durlabham || 17 ||
devi tasminn avasare śiṣyāya priyavādine | munīndro dakṣiṇāmūrtirabravīd grantham uttamam || 18 ||
bhāṣitaṃ yat purā tena tatprabhāvān maheśvari | devānāṃ devatānāṃ ca tacchṛṇuṣva bravīmyaham || 19 ||
(1.24)
(1)
tatrādau tripurā(-)mantroddhāraḥ
taduktaṃ vāmakeśvare tantre(-)
lakṣmīḥ parā madana(-)vāgbhavaśaktiyuktā | tāraṃ ca bhūtikamalā kathitāpi vidyā || 20 ||
śaktyādikaṃ ca viparītatayā ca proktā | śrīṣoḍaśākṣara(-)vidhiḥ śubhado'stu pūrṇaḥ || 21 ||
uḍḍāmare ca(-)
kṣīrodasaṃbhavā bhūtiḥ kāmavāgbhavam eva ca | śaktiḥ praṇavalajje'pi lakṣmīḥ śaktyādikaṃ tataḥ | viparītatayā proktā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarī || 22 ||
rudrayāmale'pi(-)
hariṇākṣī tathā māyā kāmarājaśca vāsanā śarat | tryakṣaṃ tathā kṣāmā lakṣmīḥ śaktyādikaṃ tataḥ | viparītatayā proktā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarī || 23 ||
(1) atha lakṣmī(-)bījāni
uktaṃ ca chinnārahasye(-)
lakṣmīḥ padmā hariṇākṣī saroruhanivāsinī |
(1.28)
kamalā rukmiṇī caiva nārāyaṇa(-)priyāpi ca | lakṣmī(-)bījāni saptaiva kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 24 ||
aparaṃ ca tripurātilake(-)
ime dve kamalā padmā harikāntā tathaiva ca | śriyo bījāni pañcaivamanṛtānyaparāṇi ca || 25 ||
(2) atha hrīṃ(-)bījāni
uktaṃ cāgamālaṃkāre(-)
parā bhūtim tathā lajjā māyāpi sakalā kṛśā | samastāpi tathā kṣāmā devī praṇava(-)vīrakau | vāraṇārṇaṃ sudhābījaṃ kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 26 ||
(3) tato madanabījāni
uktaṃ ca bhairavatantre(-)
kāmaḥ pañceṣureva ca madano manmathastathā | māraḥ pradyumnakandarpāvanṛtānyaparāṇi ca || 27 ||
(4) tato vāgbhavabījāni
uktaṃ ca tripurāsarvasve(-)
vāgbhavaṃ cordhvabījaṃ ca cāraṇaṃ caṇḍikeśvaraḥ | candro'pi carmavasanaṃ vāsanāpi tathaiva ca | cārvaṅgyapi ca carmāṇamasatyānyaparāṇi ca || 28 ||
(1.31)
(5) tataḥ śaktibījāni
uktaṃ chinnāśiromaṇau(-)
śaktiḥ śarmāpi vijñeye śaracchaṅke tathaiva ca | śakterbījāni catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 29 ||
(6) tata oṃkārabījāni
praṇavaṃ ca tathā tāraṃ tryakṣa tomāpi tryambakaḥ | trāsastārava etāni bījāni praṇavasya ca | aparāṇi hyasatyāni mayā proktāni pārvati || 30 ||
viparītatayā proktā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarī || 31 ||
prakāśam
śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ sauḥ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ka e ī la hrīṃ ha sakala hrīṃ sakala hrīṃ sauḥ aiṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ||
(1.37)
uktaṃ cāgamalaharyām(-)
tripurā śrīśca vāgdevī tārāpi bhuvaneśvarī | mātaṅgī śārikā rājñī bheḍā jvālāmukhī tathā | daśavidyāḥ svayaṃ caitā bhāṣitāḥ kṛttivāsasā || 32 ||
vāmakeśvare ṣoḍaśavidyāḥ(-)
etā daśaiva ṣaḍanyā yojitā ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 33 ||
daśavidyā bhadrakālī turī ca chinnamastakā | dakṣiṇākālikā śyāmā kālarātryapi sundari || 34 ||
etāsāṃ mūlamantreṇa yojitaikākṣareṇa ca | brahmādidaivataiḥ pūjyā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarī || 35 ||
(2)
tato lakṣmī(-)mantroddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca rudrayāmale(-)
hariṇākṣī parā tryakṣaṃ lakṣmī(-)bījatrayam idam | viparītatayā proktaṃ satvaraṃ phaladāyakam | kṣāmā śaṅkāpi nīraṃ tadante proktaṃ śiṣyottama || 36 ||
(7) tato nīrabījāni
uktaṃ coḍḍāmare(-)
(1.39)
āpo vanaṃ tathā nīraṃ ṭha(-)dvayaṃ ca payastathā | jalaṃ bījāni proktāni ṣaḍ asatyānyaparāṇi ca || 37 ||
prakāśam
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ lakṣmi mahālakṣmi sarvakāmaprade sarvasaubhāgyadāyini abhimataṃ prayaccha sarve sarvagate sarvasvarūpe sarvadurjayavimocini hrīṃ sauḥ svāhā ||
(3)
tataḥ sarasvatī(-)mantroddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca śāradāpaṭale(-)
tāraṃ lajjā vāgbhavaṃ ca parā praṇavam eva ca | bījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyam ante jñeyaṃ nama iti || 38 ||
prakāśam
oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ hrīṃ oṃ vāgdevyai namaḥ ||
(8) tato namo(-)bījāni
uktaṃ cāgamālaṃkāre(-)
(1.42)
namo viśvaṃ tathā stambhaṃ sauṣmakam aśmarī tathā | anyāni kṛtrimāṇyeva surāsura(-)namaskṛte || 39 ||
(4)
tatastārā(-)mantranirṇayaḥ
uktaṃ ca bhairavasarvasve(-)
tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ tathā kāntā māyā vāgbhavam eva ca | kūrcaṃ caiva maheśāni hyante phaṭ ṭha(-)dvayaṃ tathā || 40 ||
(9) tato hrāṃ(-)bījoddhāraḥ
uktaṃ cāgamasindhau(-)
skanda vyoṣaṃ ca ḍimbaṃ ca saṃyojya ha(-)ram ityataḥ | hrāṃ(-)bījoddhāram etaddhi cānyad anṛtam āvadet || 41 ||
(10) tataḥ strī(-)bījoddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca vāmakeśvare(-)
kāntā ca kamalākṣī ca priyāpi paramāpi ca | lambhāpi lalanā lājā hyasatyānyaparāṇi ca || 42 ||
(1.46)
(11) tataḥ kūrca(-)bījoddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca chinnārahasye(-)
kūrcaṃ kūlaṃ taṭaṃ tīram asatyānyaparāṇi ca || 43 ||
(12) tataḥ phaṭ(-)bījoddhāraḥ
asminn eva(-)
phaṭ haraṃ turagaṃ cānyad asatyaṃ tu sureśvari || 44 ||
prakāśam
oṃ hrāṃ strīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ hūṃ ugratāre phaṭ svāhā ||
(5)
tato bhuvaneśvarī(-)mantroddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca kubjikāsarvasve(-)
praṇavaṃ ca tathā māyā kamalā manmathastathā | ante viśvaṃ nāma madhye proktaṃ vai tu sureśvari | prokto'yaṃ bhuvaneśvaryā manus turyākṣarābhidhaḥ || 45 ||
(13) atha mantra(-)bījoddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca svatantre tripurā(-)ṭīkāyām(-)
mantro manurharaścaiva hanurvālaṃ vidurbudhāḥ | bījānyetāni mantrasya kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 46 ||
hara(-)bījau dvau mantraḥ phaṭ ca ||

prakāśam

(6)
tato mātaṅgī(-)mantroddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca kulasiddhasaṃtāne(-)
tomā kālī tathā lakṣmīrvā gurā dvayameva ca | cārukaṃ rasabījāni hyādau proktāni śaṃbhunā || 47 ||
ante jihvā tathā padmaṃ lajjā nīrajameva ca | vāsanā paṅkajaṃ caiva vanaṃ proktaṃ tu śūlinā || 48 ||
(14) atha kālī(-)bījoddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca kulacūḍāmaṇau(-)
kālī kuntī rasajñāpī jihvāpi rasanā tathā | krīṃ(-)bījāni ca hyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 49 ||
(15) athavāgurā(-)bījoddhāraḥ
vāgurā vāyupūjyāpi vāntudāsya tri(-)bījakam | prīṃ(-)bījāni tu proktāni hyasatyānyaparāṇi tu || 50 ||
(1.53)

muṇḍamālātantre(-)
cārukaṃ caiva cārvaṅgī cārutocchūna(-)bījakam | catuṣṭayaṃ ca chrīṃ(-)bījamasatyānyaparāṇi ca || 51 ||
cārvaṅgī(-)bījau dvau chrīṃ aiṃ ||

uktaṃ ca vāmakeśvare(-)
padmaṃ paṅkaja(-)payoje nīrajamambujaṃ tathā | pañca ṭhakāra(-)bījāni hyanṛtānyaparāṇi ca || 52 ||
prakāśam
oṃ krīṃ śrīṃ prīṃ prīṃ chrīṃ ucchiṣṭa caṇḍālini devi mahāpiśācini mātaṃgi devi krīṃ ṭhaḥ hrīṃ ṭhaḥ aiṃ ṭhaḥ svāhā ||

tāraṃ māyāṃ śriyaṃ kūrcaṃ sindhuraṃ śūnyameva ca | kalyāṇaṃ śārikā(-)devyā bījaṃ saptākṣaraṃ smṛtam | ante stambhaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ śārikā(-)mūlam uttamam || 53 ||
(18) tataḥ sindhurabījoddhāraḥ
uktaṃ ca vāmakeśvare tantre(-)
sindhuraṃ ca gajaṃ ghoṇā hastinaṃ dviradaṃ tathā | hrāṃ(-)bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 54 ||
(19) tata ākāśabījāni
uktaṃ ca bhairave tantre(-)
śūnyaṃ kham ambaraṃ vyoma āṃ(-)bījaṃ ca catuṣṭayam | hakāraṃ caiva vijñeyam uktaṃ ca rudrayāmale | asatyam aparaṃ jñeyaṃ tārābhaktisamanvita || 55 ||
(20) tataḥ kalyāṇabījāni
asminneva(-)
kalyāṇaṃ caiva śarmāpi śaṃ śubhaṃ ca catuṣṭayam | anṛtam aparaṃ jñeyaṃ parvateśvara(-)nandini || 56 ||
śarma(-)bījau dvau sauḥ śaṃ ca ||

ma la hrīṃ sauḥ khecaryai namaḥ ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi dhyānān āgama niścitān | etāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ devavandite || 17 ||
tathā saptakumārāṇāṃ dhyānaṃ tatra viniścitam | tathā bhedavihīnānāṃ śṛṇu pārvati tattvataḥ || 18 ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrti viracita uddhārakośe tridevī khecarīṇāṃ kośākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpaḥ] || 6 ||
(7.9)
athādau daśavidyānāṃ dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | vāmakeśvara tantroktaṃ tripurāyāḥ sureśvari || 1 ||
divyāmbarāṅkita tanuṃ mihirāgni candra netrām | sudhāṃśu mukuṭāṃ hima saṃnibhābhām || 2 ||
siṃhāsanāṃ paraśu khaḍgadharāṃ bhujābhyām | brahmendra viṣṇunamitāṃ tripurāṃ bhaje'ham || 3 ||
atha vakṣye śriyo dhyānaṃ bhāṣitaṃ rudrayāmale | munisādhaka gīrvāṇa vipravargaiḥ supūjite || 4 ||
lakṣmīṃ padmāsanagata kaṭiṃ sūrya śītāṃśu netrām | udyadbhāsvat kanakaruciṃ padmaśaṅkhāsi pāṇim || 5 ||
nānāmuktāmaṇi suśakalābhūṣitāṅgīṃ dvibāhum | nityaṃ lokatritaya phaladāṃ naumyahaṃ bhaktipūrvam || 6 ||
atha vakṣyāmi vāgdevyā dhyānaṃ vidyāpradaṃ śive | tantramuktāvalau granthe durlabhe tridive'pi ca || 7 ||
vāṇīṃ pūrṇa niśākarojjvalamukhīṃ karpūrakundaprabhām | candrārdhāṅkita mastakāṃ nijakaraiḥ saṃbibhratīmādarāt || 8 ||
vīṇām akṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhya kalaśaṃ vidyāṃ ca tuṅgastanīm | divyair ābharaṇairvibhūṣita tanuṃ siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ bhaje || 9 ||
(7.19)
atha vakṣyāmi tārāyā dhyānaṃ bhairavatantrake | devyā bhedavihīnāyā munisādhaka pūjite || 10 ||
devīṃ pannaga bhūṣitāṃ himaruciṃ śītāṃśu śaṅkhaprabhām | muktāratna parītakaṇṭhavalayāṃ raktāmbarāṃ vibhratīm || 11 ||
śūlābjāsi gadā dharāṃ suragaṇairvaikuṇṭha mukhyaiḥ stutām | nityaṃ lokatrayaika rakṣaṇaparāṃ tārāṃ trinetrāṃ bhaje || 12 ||
athāhaṃ bhuvaneśvaryā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu | sādhakeṣṭa prade granthe niḥsmṛtaṃ rudrayāmale || 13 ||
udyadbhānu sahasrasaṃnibhamukhīṃ pīnastanīṃ padmagām | dorbhir aṅkuśapāśapustakajayān saṃbibhratīṃ sādarāt || 14 ||
brahma viṣṇu maheśvarendra munibhirnityaṃ stutāṃ vandanaiḥ | stotrādyairbhuvaneśvarīṃ trinayanāṃ hṛtpaṅkaje'haṃ bhaje || 15 ||
atha vakṣyāmi mātaṅgyā dhyānaṃ parvata nandini | kubjikāsarvasve granthe mamāpyatyanta durlabhe || 16 ||
candrārdhāṅkita śekharāṃ trinayanāṃ koṭīndu sūrya prabhām | nānāratna sahasra baddharasanāṃ pretāsane saṃsthitām || 17 ||
śaṅkhaṃ tomara paṭṭisābjayugalāṃ dorbhirvahantīṃ mudā | dhyāye'haṃ hṛdaye sadā bhagavatīṃ mātaṅginīṃ hāriṇīm || 18 ||
atha vakṣye maheśāni śārikādhyānam uttamam |
(7.28)
āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ niḥsmṛtaṃ durlabhaṃ janaiḥ || 19 ||
śrīśaṅkhacakra musalāmbujayugmahastām | nāgendra hāravalayāṅkita kaṇṭhamālām || 20 ||
sindūrakuṅkuma sahasramarīci dīptim | śrīśārikāṃ tri(-)nayanāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 21 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi rājñī dhyānam anuttamam | vāmakeśvara tantroktaṃ parvateśvara nandini || 22 ||
śītāṃśu vālārka kṛśānu netrām | caturbhujām eṇa tvag āsanasthām || 23 ||
śaṅkhābja śūlāsi dharāṃ maheśīm | rājñīṃ bhaje'haṃ tuhinādri rūpām || 24 ||
atha vakṣyāmi bheḍāyā dhyānam icchāphalapradam | niḥsmṛtam āgamoddyote mayā viracite svayam || 25 ||
udyacchītāṃśu raśmidyuti caya sadṛśīm | phulla padmopaviṣṭāṃ vīṇā nāgendra śaṅkhām || 26 ||
yudha paraśudharāṃ dorbhir īḍyaiścaturbhiḥ | muktā hārāṃśu nānāmaṇiyuta hṛdayām || 27 ||
sīdhu pātraṃ vahantīṃ vande bheḍā bhavānīm | prahasita vadanāṃ sādhakeṣṭa pradātrīm || 28 ||
(7.36)
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi jvālāmukhyā anuttamam | dhyānaṃ mayā viracite granthe jvālāśiromaṇau || 29 ||
jvālā parītāsya śiroruhāṃ tāṃ saroja śaṅkhāsi gadā dharāṃ ca | siṃhāsane sthāpita pādayugmāṃ jvālāmukhīṃ suhṛdaye smarāmi || 30 ||
athāhaṃ bhadrakālyāśca dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsmṛtam | svayaṃ mayā viracite tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 31 ||
muṇḍaṃ viśvasya kartuḥ karakamalatale dhārayantīṃ hasantīm | nāhaṃ tṛptā vadantīṃ sakalajana cayaṃ bhakṣayantīṃ sadaiva || 32 ||
śyāmāṃ viṣṇuṃ girīśam arikulamathanaṃ dorbhir īḍyairdhṛtāsim | dhyāye'haṃ bhadrakālīṃ navajalaviṣadāṃ pretamadhyāsanasthām || 33 ||
turī dhyānamahaṃ vakṣye niḥsmṛtam āgamāmṛte | asmiṃścarācare khyāte brahmaṇaiva prakāśite || 34 ||
nānāratna nibaddha candraśakalāṃ maulau jaṭābhirvṛte | pāśāmbhojadharāṃ himāṃśu dhavalāṃ dorbhyāṃ dvibāhuṃ śivām || 35 ||
sūryendvagni vilocanāṃ sitamukhīṃ pretāsane saṃsthitām | brahmā viṣṇu maheśvaraiśca namitāṃ devīṃ bhaje'haṃ turīm || 36 ||
(7.46)
athādau chinnamastāyā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsmṛtam | svakṛte tripurāyāśca granthe devi śiromaṇau || 37 ||
aiṇāṅkāṃśu parītabhāla phalakāṃ bālārka koṭiprabhām | jvālābaddha mahārgha ratnanicayāṃ kandarpa darpojjvalām || 38 ||
śūlāsyaṅkuśa pāśa veṇumusalāmbhojān bhayān bibhratīm | bhakteṣṭāṃ chinnamastakāṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāye hṛdabje sadā || 39 ||
dakṣiṇākālikāyāśca dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsmṛtam | granthe kālīrahasye'smin parvateśvara nandini || 40 ||
brahmā viṣṇu śivāsthi muṇḍarasanāṃ tāmbūlaraktādharām | varṣāmegha nibhāṃ triśūla musalau padmāsi pāśāṅkuśān || 41 ||
śaṅkhaṃ sāhiyugaṃ dhṛtāṃ daśabhujāṃ pretāsane saṃsthitām | devīṃ dakṣiṇakālikāṃ bhagavatīṃ raktāmbarāṃ tāṃ smare || 42 ||
atha vakṣyāmi śyāmāyā dhyānaṃ parvata nandini | śyāmā tantre mayākhyātaṃ sakalāgama sāgare || 43 ||
trailokya pūjita padāmburuha dvayāṃ tām | kṛṣṇāmbubhṛt sadṛśa rūpadharāṃ trinetrām || 44 ||
śūlāsi śaṅkhamahatīṃ svabhujairvahantīm | śyāmāṃbhaje śavaśarīra kṛtāsanasthām || 45 ||
athāhaṃ kālarātryāste dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsmṛtam | mayā viracite devi tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 46 ||
(7.56)
śūlābjapāśāṅkuśa padmahastāṃ caturbhujāṃ dhūmanibhāṃ trinetrām | siṃhāsanasthāṃ dhṛta pītavastrāṃ dhyāye maheśīṃ hṛdi kālarātrīm || 47 ||
nānābharaṇa saṃyukte devi vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | śrīvajrayoginī dhyānaṃ niḥsmṛtaṃ kulikārṇave || 48 ||
indvagni sūryanayanāṃ pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ śivām | dvibhujāṃ siṃham adhyasthāṃbhaje'haṃ vajrayoginīm || 49 ||
atha vakṣyāmi vārāhyā dhyānaṃ tantraviniścitam | yathābhīṣṭa pradaṃ devi kulacūḍāmaṇau priye || 50 ||
candrārdha cūḍāṃ dvibhujāṃ bhujābhyāṃ śūlāṅkuśau śyāmamukhīṃ vahantīm | sūryāgni candrīkṛta dṛṣṭi pātāṃ dhyāye hṛdabje vimalāṃ varāhīm || 51 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi śāradā dhyānam uttamam | śāradāpaṭale granthe racite'pi mayā svayam || 52 ||
ṣaḍbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ smitānanāṃ śāṇḍilyarṣistuta pādapaṅkajām | parvate sthitavatīṃ dhṛtaśūlāṃ śāradāṃ bhagavatīṃ hṛdi dhyāye || 53 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi tvaṃ śṛṇu dhyānam uttamam | kāmeśvaryāstripurāyāḥ sarvasve tantrakottame || 54 ||
trilocanāṃ sūrya sahasra śobhāṃ siṃhāsanasthāṃ dvibhujāṃ dhṛtāsim | pītāmbarāṃ viṣṇu maheśa sevyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 55 ||
atha vakṣyāmi gauryāste dhyānaṃ bhairavatantrake | granthe mayā viracite parvateśvara nandini || 56 ||
(7.65)
gaurāṅgīṃ dhṛtapaṅkajāṃ trinayanāṃ śvetāmbarāṃ siṃhagām | candrodbhāsita śekharāṃ smitamukhīṃ dorbhyāṃ vahantīṃ gadām || 57 ||
viṣṇvindrāmbuja yoniśaṃbhu tridaśaiḥ saṃpūjitāṃghri dvayām | gaurīṃ mānasa paṅkajāṃ bhagavatīṃ bhakteṣṭadāṃ tāṃ bhaje || 58 ||
athāham annapūrṇāyā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | niḥsmṛtaṃ bhairave tantre mayā devi prakāśite || 59 ||
candrārdhamauliṃ dvibhujāṃ trinetrāṃ śūlākṣamāle dvibhujairvahantīm | eṇāsanasthāṃ bhujagopavītāṃ tām annapūrṇāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 60 ||
kulavāgīśvarī dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu priye | āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ durlabhāyāṃ mamāpi ca || 61 ||
triśūlāsi dharāṃ dorbhyāṃ raktāsyāṃ vahnisaṃnibhām | tryakṣāṃ siṃhāsanagatāṃ kulavāgīśvarīṃ bhaje || 62 ||
atha vakṣye gaṇeśasya dhyānaṃ gīrvāṇapūjite | āgamārṇavapīpūṣe durlabhe bhuvane'mbike || 63 ||
dvicaturdaśavarṇa bhūcitaṃ musalāmbhojadharamahyupavītam | dvimṛgādhipa gāminaṃ trinetraṃ śivaputraṃ dviradānanaṃ bhaje'ham || 64 ||
atha dhyānaṃ kumārasya vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati | niḥsmṛtam āgamoddyote mayā viracite śive || 65 ||
(7.75)
himādri śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ bhujaṅgaiḥ parītagātraṃ śikhiviṣṭarastham | nāgendra kanyā priyaputram ādyaṃ hṛdi smare'bhīṣṭapradaṃ kumāram || 66 ||
haihayasya bravīmyevaṃ dhyānaṃ tava kutūhalāt | yathābhīṣṭa pradaṃ nṛṇām uḍḍāmara viniścitam || 67 ||
sahasrabhuja maṇḍalī jitatamīcareśādhipam (?) | himāṃśu sadṛśānanaṃ dhṛtasahasra tūṇīrakam || 68 ||
sitāmbaradharaṃ sadā turagarāja madhyasthitam | smarāmi bhuvanādhipaṃ hṛdi tu kārtavīryārjunam || 69 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi dhyānaṃ tasya viniḥ smṛtam | mṛtyuṃjayasya devasya granthe kubjāśiromaṇau || 70 ||
candrodbhāsita mūrdhajaṃ surapatiṃ pīyūṣapātraṃ vahan | hastābjena sudhāṃśu koṭi vimalaṃ hāsyasya paṅkeruham || 71 ||
sūryāgnīndu vilocanaṃ karatalaiḥ pāśākṣa sūtrāṅkuśā(-) mbhojān bibhratam akṣayaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ taṃ smare || 72 ||
sugrīvasyātha vakṣye'haṃ dhyānaṃ parvatanandini | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe nirmite mantrasāgare || 73 ||
bālaṃ ṣoḍaśa hāyanaṃ kapi patiṃ vahniprabhā bhāsvaram | dorbhirvṛkṣagadā dhanuḥ śaracayān saṃbibhrataṃ sādarāt || 74 ||
vandyaṃ devasvarūpiṇaṃ raghupatiṃ cārādhayantam mudā | dhyāye'haṃ bhagavantam arkatanayaṃ sugrīvadevaṃ hṛdi || 75 ||
(7.84)
athāhaṃ te hanumato dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsmṛtam | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe parvateśvara nandini || 76 ||
rāmeṣṭa mitraṃ jagad eka vīraṃ plavaṅga rājendra kṛta praṇāmam | sumeru śṛṅgābham acintyam ādyaṃ hṛdi smare'haṃ hanumantam īḍyam || 77 ||
atha te bhairavasyāhaṃ dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi pārvati | niḥsmṛtaṃ bhairave tantre yathābhīṣṭa phalapradam || 78 ||
kapālahastaṃ bhujagopavītaṃ kṛṣṇachaviṃ daṇḍadharaṃ trinetram | acintyam ādyaṃ madhupāna saktaṃ hṛdi smare bhairavam iṣṭadaṃ tam || 79 ||
atha vakṣyāmi sūryasya dhyānaṃ tantra viniścitam | tripurāsarvasve granthe dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛte || 80 ||
pratyakṣa devaṃ viṣadaṃ sahasramarīcibhiḥ śobhita bhūmideśam | saptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastam ādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabje || 81 ||
atha vakṣyāmi saumyasya dhyānaṃ bhairavatantrake | yathā bhīṣṭa pradaṃ satyaṃ surāsura namaskṛte || 82 ||
somātmajaṃ haṃsagataṃ dvibāhuṃ śaṅkhendu rūpaṃ hyasi pāśahastam | dayānidhiṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgaṃ budhaṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 83 ||
atha vakṣyāmi śukrasya dhyānaṃ tantra viniścitam | kubjikāsarvasve granthe brahmaṇaiva prakāśite || 84 ||
(7.92)
saṃtapta kāñcana nibhaṃ dvibhujaṃ dayāluṃ pītāmbaraṃ dhṛtasaroruha dvaṃdva śūlam | krauṃcāsanaṃ ca sura sevita pādapadmaṃ śukraṃ smaredvijayanaṃ hṛdayāmbuje'ham || 85 ||
atha vakṣyāmi jīvasya śṛṇu pārvati tattvataḥ | dhyānaṃ bhairavatantroktaṃ sakalārtha pradaṃ nṛṇām || 86 ||
tajo mayaṃ śakti triśūlahastaṃ surendra jyeṣṭhastuta pādapadmam | medhā nidhiṃ matsyagataṃ (?) dvi(-)bāhuṃ guruṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 87 ||
atha vakṣyāmi candrasya dhyānaṃ devi śṛṇu priye | niḥsmṛtam āgamoddyote nānā dhyāna saritpatau || 88 ||
śaṅkha prabham eṇa priyaṃ śaśāṅkam īśānamauli sthitam īḍyarūpam | tamīpatim ambuja yugma hastaṃ dhyāye hṛdabje śaśinaṃ graheśam || 89 ||
atha vakṣyāmi bhaumasya dhyānaṃ tantra viniścitam | āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ śṛṇuṣvaika manāḥ priye || 90 ||
pratapta gāṅgeya nibhaṃ graheśaṃ siṃhāsanasthaṃ kamalāsihastam | surāsuraiḥ pūjita pādapadmaṃ bhaumaṃ dayāluṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 91 ||
atha vakṣye śanerdhyānaṃ yathābhīṣṭa phalapradam | niḥsmṛtaṃ ca maheśāni śubhadam āgamāmṛte || 92 ||
(7.100)
nīlāñjanābhaṃ mihireṣṭa putraṃ graheśvaraṃ pāśa bhujaṅga pāṇim | surāsurāṇāṃ bhayadaṃ dvibāhuṃ smare śaniṃ mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 93 ||
athāhaṃ saiṃhikeyasya dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | niḥsmṛtaṃ phaladaṃ nṛṇāṃ tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 94 ||
śītāṃśu mitrāntakam īḍya rūpaṃ ghoraṃ ca vaiḍūrya nibhaṃ dvibāhum | trailokya rakṣā param iṣṭadaṃ ca rāhuṃ grahendraṃ hṛdaye bhaje'ham || 95 ||
atha vakṣyāmi ketośca dhyānam āgama niścitam | niḥsmṛtaṃ āgamoddyote granthe vai mantrasāgare || 96 ||
lāṅgūla yuktaṃ bhayadaṃ janānāṃ kṛṣṇāmbubhṛt saṃnibham ekavīram | kṛṣṇāmbaraṃ śakti triśūlahastaṃ ketuṃ bhaje mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 97 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi bhavānī dhyānam uttamam | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe niḥsmṛtaṃ bhuvaneśvari || 98 ||
ariśaṅkha kṛpāṇa kheṭavāṇān svadhanuḥ śūlaka tarjanīṃ dadhānām | bhayadāṃ mahiṣottamāṅga saṃsthāṃ navadūrvā sadṛśīṃ bhaje bhavānīm || 99 ||
athāhaṃ bagalāmukhyā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsmṛtam |
(7.107)
āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ surāsura namaskṛte || 100 ||
nānāratna nibaddha ramya mukuṭāṃ pītāmbarāṃ bhāgyadām | gharmāṃśvagni śaśāṅkaraśmi nayanāṃ siṃhāsanasthāṃ śivām || 101 ||
sadgāṅgeya nibhāṃ mahārgha maṇibhirudbhāsitāṅgīṃ sadā | devīṃ śrībagalāmukhīṃ hṛdi bhaje bhakteṣṭadāṃ muktidām || 102 ||
atha vakṣye śṛṇoṣi tvam indrākṣī dhyānam uttamam | niḥsmṛtaṃ jagad īśāni granthe vai rudrayāmale || 103 ||
mālāsyaṅkuśa padmayugmakadhrāṃ sāhasranetrāṃ śivām | mattairāvaṇa pṛṣṭhagāṃ śaśimukhīṃ trailokyarakṣāparām || 104 ||
dorbhirgānaratāṃ sphuṭāmbujanibhāṃ brahmādi devaiḥ stutām | indrākṣīṃ janamātaraṃ hṛdi bhaje kāruṇyarūpāṃ parām || 105 ||
atha vakṣye maheśāni khecarīdhyānam uttamam | yāṃ dhyātvā khecarīṃ yogī jīvanmukto bhavet kalau | granthe bhairavatantrākhye niḥsmṛta tridaśārcite || 106 ||
vinidrakamalotpalairmunibhirarcitāṃghri dvayām | sitāsita karānanāṃ sitakarojjvala śekharām || 107 ||
(7.113)
ravīnduśikhilocanām abhayapustakau bibhratīm | smarāmi hṛdi khecarīṃ bhuvanamātaraṃ siddhidām || 108 ||
etāsāṃ devadeveśi mantradhyānacayaṃ smṛtam | yasya kasya na dātavyaṃ grantham uddhārakośakam || 109 ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
dhanyaḥ sa yasya putrastvaṃ sakalāgama pāragaḥ | jayatvaṃ svagṛhaṃ gantum ājñāpayitumarhasi || 110 ||
śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtiruvāca
gacchadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve kṣamadhvaṃ kṛpayā mama | ityuktā munayo jagmuḥ svagṛhaṃ mantralālasāḥ || 111 ||
īśvara uvāca
dakṣiṇāmūrtinā tena dṛṣṭvā tantrān manoramān | kṛtam uddhārakośākhyaṃ granthaṃ gopyatamaṃ kuru || 112 ||
